tez: Dollar General presents a defensible investment thesis supported by solid earnings growth, attractive cash flow yields, and robust fundamental health. TTM parent-attributed free cash flow yield of 7.84% and a P/E of 17.96x offer reasonable valuation backing, complemented by a strong Piotroski F-Score of 7/9 and low short-term refinancing risk. While fiscal Q1 2026 operating cash flow experienced a temporary year-over-year contraction of 15.5%, core operating income grew 10.8% and net income grew 13.3%, indicating solid underlying operational profitability.
